candidates.statement: Inventory's Redis reserve_inventory calls time out (~2s), returning 503 on /v1/reservations; order's calls to inventory then ReadTimeout, producing 502 on /v1/orders and /v1/checkout.
candidates.uncertainty: Redis-side metrics/logs excluded from context; whether the timeout stems from Redis saturation vs network is unconfirmed.

report.explanation: Traces show redis.reserve_inventory timeouts in inventory, cascading ReadTimeouts to order and 502s at checkout; inventory metrics show 503s on /v1/reservations and Redis reserve_inventory failures. Bounded candidate: redis-timeout.
missing_evidence: Redis server-side latency/saturation metrics to confirm the timeout origin
Inventory logs (ev-...-r1-inventory-logs) to corroborate the Redis timeout errors
